categories.main_business_segments: Taiwan Shin Kong Security Co., Ltd. primarily operates in security services including electronic security systems, cash and valuables transportation, on-site security personnel services, personal security and special guard services, multi-point video monitoring, fire alarm services, access control and attendance systems, smart elderly care, and retail/restaurant POS systems. The company also engages in the development and sales of security equipment and related consulting services, with subsidiaries focusing on product manufacturing and specialized service sectors such as long-term care and smart building management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced electronic security technologies including wired and wireless alarm systems, AI-based video surveillance and intrusion detection, GPS tracking, cloud-based management platforms, and integrated building management systems (IBMS). It develops proprietary security hardware and software, including multi-functional control panels, AI image recognition, and smart home security solutions. Production and R&D are supported by subsidiaries specializing in electronic components and system integration, emphasizing innovation in wireless security and AI applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include financial institutions, government agencies, commercial enterprises, residential communities, retail chains, and healthcare facilities. The company serves both corporate and individual clients, providing tailored security solutions for offices, factories, warehouses, residential buildings, and public venues. It also targets emerging markets such as smart elderly care and smart city infrastructure, addressing the needs of aging populations and urban safety management.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across Taiwan, with over 70 service locations covering major cities and regions including Taipei, New Taipei, Keelung, Taoyuan, Hsinchu, Taichung, Tainan, Kaohsiung, and outlying islands such as Penghu. It also has plans to expand into China and Southeast Asian markets depending on regional conditions. The service network is comprehensive, ensuring nationwide coverage for security and monitoring services.
categories.supply_chain_position: Taiwan Shin Kong Security operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the security industry supply chain. It manufactures and develops security equipment through subsidiaries (upstream activities) but mainly focuses on system integration, service provision, and customer support (midstream and downstream). The company also manages logistics and deployment of security personnel, positioning itself as a full-service security solutions provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes a dual-axis transformation strategy combining technological innovation and sustainability. R&D priorities include wireless security systems, AI-enhanced video surveillance, smart elderly care technologies, and integrated building management platforms. It invests in digital transformation, AI applications, and green energy initiatives, aiming to enhance service efficiency, reduce carbon footprint, and expand smart city and long-term care service offerings. The company also pursues ESG goals and continuous improvement in information security.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service contracts for electronic security system installation and monitoring, cash and valuables transportation fees, on-site security personnel deployment, and sales or leasing of security equipment. Additional income streams include consulting services, smart care solutions, and software platform subscriptions. The company also earns from product sales via subsidiaries and long-term service agreements with corporate and government clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading security service provider in Taiwan, competing closely with Chung Hsing Security, which currently holds a market leadership position by revenue. Taiwan Shin Kong Security has rapidly grown to become a strong contender, leveraging its integration with the Shin Kong Group and extensive service network. Its competitive advantages include advanced technology adoption, comprehensive service offerings, and strong brand reputation supported by certifications and ESG commitments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$7.85 billion, representing a 1.7% growth over the previous year. Net profit after tax was about NT$941 million, a slight decrease of 6.6%. The company maintains a stable financial position with total assets around NT$19 billion and equity of approximately NT$12.9 billion. It has a workforce of about 6,500 employees and continues to invest in R&D with planned expenditures of around NT$15 million for the upcoming year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Taiwan Shin Kong Security differentiates itself by integrating advanced technology such as AI and IoT into traditional security services, offering comprehensive, customized solutions that enhance safety and operational efficiency. Its extensive nationwide service network, strong R&D capabilities, and commitment to ESG principles provide customers with reliable, innovative, and sustainable security services. The company’s affiliation with the Shin Kong Group enables cross-industry synergies, adding value through diversified service offerings including healthcare and smart building management.
